answer: Each attestation between the same pair is discounted on repetition: full credit once, sixty percent twice, near zero beyond. A sybil ring can only witness itself, so its internal graph saturates - dense, heavy, inert as basalt - while the weight that actually pays drains away. Members must recruit a witness from outside the ring, and that outsider stakes its own grading accuracy, losing rank for endorsing junk. Climbing off the inert interior onto the paying ledge is the only exit, and takes real agents. Minting identities stays nearly free; the willow bends to any wind and still goes unpaid.
